mapper.update: UPDATE procurement_payable_reservation SET version=2,state_json=#{stateJson},released_at=#{releasedAt},active_request_id=NULL,active_payable_reference=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=1
mapper.select: SELECT o.state_json AS settlement_json,b.state_json AS bank_json FROM supplier_payable_settlement_operation o JOIN supplier_payment_operation b ON b.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND b.id=o.payment_id JOIN supplier_payable_settlement_revision r ON r.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND r.operation_id=o.id AND r.version=o.version JOIN supplier_payment_revision p ON p.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND p.operation_id=b.id AND p.version=b.version WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND o.id=#{id} AND o.version=#{version} AND o.status='SETTLED' AND o.retired_version IS NULL AND o.active_payment_id=b.id AND o.command_json=#{stateJson} AND o.command_digest=#{digest} AND b.version=#{expectedVersion} AND b.status='SUCCEEDED' AND b.command_json=#{commandJson} AND b.command_digest=#{commandDigest} AND r.state_json=o.state_json AND p.state_json=b.state_json
mapper.update: UPDATE procurement_payable_reservation SET version=2,state_json=#{stateJson},settled_at=#{settledAt},settlement_id=#{id},settlement_version=#{version},active_request_id=NULL,active_payable_reference=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{expectedId} AND version=1
